flags: FEES: stored nightly_low 15 is the pass-holder rate in rec.gov's rate table; the base rates are $20 non-electric / $30 electric (rec.gov = FS). Extra-vehicle fee exists, amount not posted.

WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' stands at the waterfront level. The North Fork here is ~40-50 m wide (river). Nearest sites to its high-water bank: 016 (44.45507,-109.73335) ~41 m, 017 (44.45494,-109.73307) ~43 m, 018 (44.45475,-109.73261) ~48 m, 020 (44.45449,-109.73220) ~44 m, 024 (44.45387,-109.73086) ~54 m. Between 018-024 and the river is a continuous riparian conifer/willow belt; between 016/017 and the river the belt is scattered shrubs and junipers. LEAD for the reviewer: possible 'riverview' from 016/017 (FS: 'sites along the North Fork'); no upgrade written.

POLICY/BOOKING CONTRADICTION: the FS page says 'This site is first come, first served.', while rec.gov's catalog sells 9 sites (002, 003, 005, 006, 007, 009, 017, 021, 022) Site-Specific with a 2-day cutoff; written reservable/some_sites per rec.gov (2027 inventory not yet released).
